items.title: Chico Freeman interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2001
items.q: You know Charlie Parker was in that band, Dizzy Gillespie, Hubert Laws.

ctx.x: You know Charlie Parker was in that band, Dizzy Gillespie, Hubert Laws. So yeah, I was with Machito for I don’t know four or five years. And so I’ve played a lot of Afro-Cuban music. I’ve been to Cuba and I’ve played with Irakere and Chucho Valdez and some of the great musicians down there. I got to hear and learn about Chano Pozo and — you know I’d never met him but a guy named Changuito, who was one of the legends in Cuba at the conguero, and as well here with Tito Puente, I played with Tito Puente and Eddie…
And how about, I see you have a new thing with your father here?
